title: Require The Selected Civ7 Service Inventory
forbids: missing selected services, legacy peer services, flat control modules, gameplay modules inside control, or unselected service modules
why: The sealed product model has three semantic service authorities. Exact module inventories keep foundational control, actor-facing play, and MapGen run orchestration physically distinct.
remediate: Construct civ7-control, civ7-play, and mapgen-runs with only their selected modules; move legacy control modules to the owning service and delete superseded roots after behavior proof closes.
message: Civ7 services and modules must match the selected platform model.
